_source: Research notes Focus 1 (LibreNMS ios.inc.php: VLAN list from CISCO-VTP-MIB, only vtpVlanState 1, skip 1002-1005, dot1dTpFdbPort and dot1dBasePortIfIndex once per VLAN with context 'vlan-<N>'; Cisco doc 44800 for vtpVlanState 1.3.6.1.4.1.9.9.46.1.3.1.1.2; SNMPv3 context naming from community sources only) and Key question B (Netdata selector example sysobjectid 1.3.6.1.4.1.9.* with sysdescr 'IOS').
